Type: small glass table lamp
Use: soft accent and bedside light; bedroom, living room, home office; on a nightstand, shelf or desk
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: clear hammered glass base, light grey fabric shade, clear cord
Colors: clear, light grey
Shape: rounded bottle-shaped glass base with visible cord, short cylindrical drum shade, compact and light
Feel: airy, calm, delicate
Goes with: white or pale walls, light wood, soft neutrals; Scandinavian or minimalist rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Hammered-Glass Table Lamp, 13.5"H, Clear
product.description: The subtle sophistication of this clear, hammered-glass table lamp makes it a welcome addition to any casual space. Its clear design can match any decor and will brighten without overtaking existing design. A white shade pairs with this item to cast the perfect glow in any room of the house. 6.25"W x 6.25"D x 13.5"H This petite glass table lamp with clear white hammered glass will make the perfect addition to your living space. Sleek and simple, this accent lamp can blend into any setting. LED bulb included Assemble in 15 minutes or less Indoor use only
